payload.name: Infer writing from online forum discussion
payload.description: Apply during extraction when a user mentions joining or participating in an online forum/community and describes talking, discussing, or chatting about topics; record that they write comments/posts on those topics.
content: If a user says they joined or participate in an online forum/community and mentions talking, discussing, or chatting about subjects, extract an event memory stating they write comments/posts on those subjects, not just that they participated or talked.
Do not apply if the user explicitly indicates reading only, lurking, or offline conversations.
Preserve the subject and topics from the message exactly; use memory kind 'event', and set subject to the user.

solves: The extraction step omitted the writing aspect of a user's participation in an online forum, recording only that they joined and discussed topics. This skill ensures that when a user mentions discussing/talking in an online forum or community, the memory includes that they write comments/posts on those topics, because online forum discussions are written communications. It applies to any future message where forum/community participation is described with discussion verbs.
